broken_shroudwalker_init_01 = {
	class = "sc_trinary_2"
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				potential_shroudwalker_enclave = yes
				add = @spawn_system_extreme
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				is_fe_cluster = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_star_flag = empire_cluster
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	flags = {
			broken_shroudwalker_enclave
		}
}

orbital_ring_init_01 = {
	class = "rl_binary_stars"
	flags = { ruined_orbital_ring_system galactic_landmark_system }
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = @spawn_system_extreme
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_overlord_dlc = no
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_star_flag = empire_cluster
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.2
				closest_system = {
					has_megastructure = ring_world_ruined
					distance = {
						source = prev
						max_distance <= 200
					}
				}
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	init_effect = { }
}

salvager_enclave_init_02 = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				has_overlord_dlc = yes
				add = @spawn_system_extreme
			}
			#Should ideally be near the primary system
			modifier = {
				has_overlord_dlc = yes
				any_neighbor_system = { has_star_flag = salvager_enclave_system }
				add = 50
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				is_fe_cluster = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_star_flag = empire_cluster
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	flags = {
			salvager_enclave_system
			enclave
		}
	init_effect = { }
}
